target_source: Measured from Targets/Ava_Target_Front.png by the same tool on every run (checksum-verified); no stored target numbers to drift.
normalization: Centre errors are divided by the canonical head width (Geometry Lock head.max_width_row, 429 px), as in the approved EyeCenterError. Size errors are relative to the canonical value.
pass_rule: Each per-eye gate passes when the worse eye is within threshold.

IrisCenterError.formula: dist(render iris circle centre, canonical iris circle centre) / head_width
IrisCenterError.rationale: Same tolerance as the approved EyeCenterError.

IrisDiameterError.formula: abs(render amber width - canonical amber width) / canonical amber width
IrisDiameterError.rationale: About 3 px on a 50 px iris; the canonical raster edge is soft (upscaled), so +/-1.5 px per side.

PupilCenterError.rationale: Pupil position carries gaze; looser than iris because the canonical pupil blends into the dark upper iris.

UpperLashSpanError.formula: abs(render lash width - canonical lash width) / canonical lash width
UpperLashSpanError.rationale: Lash flick length is a stylistic detail; 10 % is about 8 px.

UpperLashTopError.formula: abs(render lash top row - canonical lash top row) / head_width
UpperLashTopError.rationale: Same tolerance as the approved EyeCenterError.

EyeOpeningSizeError.formula: (abs(dw)/w + abs(dh)/h) / 2 over the lash-to-lower-lid opening box
EyeOpeningSizeError.rationale: Twice the approved EyeSize tolerance, because the opening box has soft lid edges instead of the skin-driven window.

EyeOpeningCenterError.rationale: Same tolerance as the approved EyeCenterError.

IrisSymmetryError.formula: abs(render L/R iris-width ratio - canonical L/R ratio) / canonical ratio
IrisSymmetryError.rationale: Keeps the canonical slight left/right size difference (head turn) without demanding pixel parity.
